Apaq Technology.why: Solid / hybrid capacitor maker whose 2025 annual report attributes its revenue growth to demand for capacitors used in AI servers and names AI servers as a primary growth driver
Apaq Technology.evidence: Apaq Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026): 'Benefiting from strong growth in demand for capacitors used in AI servers, notebook computers, and automotive electronics applications, order volumes increased during the period.'

players.product: Conductive-polymer solid capacitors (coiled and chip-type, V-Chip / CAP) and hybrid capacitors for power regulation on server / AI server, motherboard, VGA and notebook boards

quarterly_data.quarter: Apaq Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 net operating revenue NT$4,474,668 thousand (+28.01%; 2024: NT$3,495,668 thousand), gross profit NT$1,550,838 thousand (+48.37%), operating profit NT$830,555 thousand (+57.98%), net profit attributable to owners of the parent NT$648,680 thousand (+21.39%). Company: 'Benefiting from strong growth in demand for capacitors used in AI servers, notebook computers, and automotive electronics applications, order volumes increased during the period', and continued capacity expansion lifted revenue; new-generation CAP, V-chip and Hybrid products raised share in server, MB, VGA and NB applications, driving shipment volume, revenue and gross margin to record highs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Apaq Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan focuses on AI Servers, AI PCs, Power and the Automotive market as primary growth drivers: expand V-Chip, high-end chip capacitor (CAP), Hybrid and SMLC capacity; increase penetration of AI server applications with high-end V-Chip, CAP and hybrid; develop high-ripple, low-ESR hybrid products for AI servers. Company: 'it is expected that the Company's sales volume for the current year will continue to grow, leading to further expansion of revenue and profits.' 2026 R&D expected to rise to about 4% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure; R&D about 4% of revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Apaq Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 revenue by product: coiled conductive polymer solid state capacitors NT$3,044,856 thousand (68.05%), chip-type conductive polymer solid state capacitors NT$1,429,812 thousand (31.95%); both used for power regulation in MB, VGA, NB, Server and HPC. Company claim: it 'has been the largest supplier of coiled solid-state capacitors in the world'. Customers above 10% of sales: ASUS 12.03% and Key Source 11.24% of 2025 sales; Gigabyte 9.01% (10.42% in 2024).
quarterly_data.figure: coiled 68.05% / chip-type 31.95% of 2025 revenue; ASUS 12.03%, Key Source 11.24%

quarterly_data.quarter: Apaq Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: property, plant and equipment rose 32% to NT$1,898,972 thousand in 2025, mainly due to the subsidiary's purchase of machinery and equipment in response to capacity expansion; subsidiary APAQ Technology (Thailand) was established in 2025 and has not yet commenced formal operations.
